breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructs to use the arithmetic-mean area and treat the result as 'exact'. The ground truth corrects this by removing the instruction entirely and instead pointing to the correct integral formula. The agent failed to resolve this. Instead of removing the incorrect instruction, it embraced it and detailed the steps for the incorrect calculation method (using the mean area), even stating to 'Treat this mean area as exact'.
